source: The Raccolta, 1857 English authorised translation by Ambrose St John
scope: Numbered index slots 1–161 only, including non-prayers. NOT 161 independent prayer works; text and cross-edition reconciliation NOT performed.
review_rules: Use historical entry number together with publication year as an index identity, not a canonical prayer ID.
Null index titles mean title transcription still outstanding, not a conjectured title. Never claim these slots are verified prayer texts.
Index titles are historical headings; they may cover programmes, activities, indulgence grants, several hymns, or composite works.
Historical indulgences are 1857 documentary context, not current 2026 indulgence grants.
Raccolta 1910 is another edition, not automatically the same entry numbers; it needs its own independent numbered ledger.
All printed scan and language/copyright release gates stay closed.
